svg.aria-label: Mean time per command. Activating an environment with modules in a login shell on an HPC system takes 525 ms with zenv and 1,586 ms by hand, against 495 ms for the shell alone. The shell hook's call on every cd takes 1.9 ms on a Mac and 2.5 ms on the HPC system, against 1.1 and 2.5 ms for an empty process.
